name: Secret Bay
insider_take: This adults-only treehouse resort redefines Caribbean luxury with clifftop villas suspended between rainforest canopy and pristine coastline.
whats_special: Secret Bay is Dominica's first and only Relais & Châteaux property, featuring award-winning bwa kwaib (Creole for "tree house") villas that blend seamlessly into the natural environment. Each villa offers complete privacy with infinity pools overlooking the Caribbean Sea, while the resort sits on 7 acres of untouched rainforest where you might spot endangered Sisserou parrots - Dominica's national bird.
pro_tip: Book the Ylang Ylang villa for the most dramatic sunset views, and time your stay during whale watching season (January-April) when humpback whales migrate through nearby waters.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Ti-Fey spa treatments using indigenous botanicals, snorkeling at nearby Champagne Reef where volcanic vents create natural bubbles, and exploring the UNESCO World Heritage Morne Trois Pitons National Park with its famous boiling lake - the world's second-largest hot spring.
pros: Ultra-private villa-style accommodations perched above a pristine rainforest bay with breathtaking Caribbean views
World-class Relais & Châteaux designation ensures exceptional culinary experiences and immaculate service standards
Unrivaled eco-luxury setting with direct access to unspoiled nature, snorkeling reefs, and hidden beaches
Highly personalized butler service and bespoke experiences tailored to each guest's preferences
Sustainably designed property that harmoniously integrates with Dominica's lush, UNESCO-recognized natural landscape
cons: Remote, secluded location requires advance planning for transportation and island access
Adults-only retreat, making it unsuitable for families traveling with children
Premium luxury pricing reflects the exclusive experience and may not suit all budgets
